programmes.programme_name: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
programmes.stipend_note: No stipend stated; corporate and merit scholarships exist (Dean's Merit List top 10%, corporate scholarships when announced).

entry_salary.basis: median full-time CTC (lakh p.a.) of M.Tech CSE, class of 2026 placement brochure; average 24.97 lakh, highest 65 lakh; includes off-campus and international offers

requirements.entrance: GATE (CS score valid as of 1 June 2026); no fixed cut-off (offers up to GATE 635 in 2025)
requirements.academic: 65% in a four-year BE/BTech (CSE, Computer Engineering, IT, Information Systems, ECE or AIML)

programmes.notes: Page: tuition INR 2,76,000/semester, INR 11,04,000 for the entire programme (4 semesters; fee table lists 2026-27 and 2027-28 at 2,76,000 per semester). Hostel and campus facility fee 39,000/semester + catering 28,800/semester (subject to revision) = 67,800 x2 = 1,35,600 per year. Other compulsory fee: insurance 3,000/year x2 = 6,000. Library deposit 4,000 and hostel caution deposit 15,000 are refundable, excluded. Median: the brochure PDF has no readable text order for the table; the text layer lists 'Highest/Average/Median' labels then MTech 65 / 24.97 / 20 (CTC) and MTech 115 / 57 / 50 (internship stipend, Rs thousand per month). Mapping 65=highest, 24.97=average, 20=median follows the label order and the same pattern holds for iMTech (89.12/33.17/30); could not render the PDF visually to confirm, so spot-check page 3 before shipping. 2026 M.Tech students are housed at the IIITB Extension Campus. 22 Oct 2026 check: the brochure's text layer lists the table labels (Highest, Average, Median) and the values 65, 24.97 and 20, but gives no column positions, and the PDF cannot be rendered here, so which number is the median could not be proven. It is consistent with the label order (median below average), so it is used but marked partial.

programmes.programme_name: Post Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics (PGDBA)
programmes.stipend_note: Not stated on the fee page.

entry_salary.basis: median CTC, PGDBA placement statistics table (2024 batch, 60 students); average INR 30 lakh; 2025 and 2026 figures not on the page

programmes.notes: Fee page: INR 25 lakh for the 2-year programme (2025-27 batch), four equal instalments; covers tuition, on-campus lodging, some books/materials, exam and lab charges; does NOT cover caution money, food or travel for the 4th-semester industrial visit. Food cost is not published so living is null. Placement table on the official page stops at 2024. A joint two-year analytics diploma, not a master's degree. Admission requirements not read.

programmes.stipend_note: Stipend INR 8,000/month plus INR 8,000/year contingency grant for non-sponsored students; sponsored candidates pay INR 50,000/semester and get no stipend.

entry_salary.basis: median of M.STAT '22 batch, ISI Placement Brochure 2022-23 (average 28.7 lakh, highest 44 lakh); stale, newer brochure not accessible

requirements.entrance: ISI admission test (direct admission for ISI B.Stat (Hons) graduates)
requirements.academic: Bachelor's degree of three or more years in any discipline

programmes.notes: Two-year programme (year 1 Delhi, year 2 Kolkata for test entrants). No tuition for non-sponsored students. Hostel payments listed (M.Stat Delhi: room rent 1,800 per 6 months; Kolkata mess deposit 18,597) are deposits, not a living-cost estimate; living null. Placement figure is from the 2022-23 brochure (M.Stat batch of 2022): the ISI placement page says a 2025-26 brochure exists but it was not reachable, so the median is 3+ years old. Not a branded data-science degree; statistics/analytics.

programmes.institution: IIT Bombay (Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management)

entry_salary.basis: median CTC of the MBA batch 2024-26 final placements (51 recruiters); average INR 28.16 lakh, highest INR 53.80 lakh

requirements.entrance: Valid CAT score, then personal interview (brochure for the 2025-27 batch)
requirements.academic: Bachelor's degree with at least 60% marks or CPI 6.5/10 (55% / 6.0 for SC/ST/PwD)
requirements.work_experience: Not required (work experience counts in selection score)

programmes.notes: Fee circular MBA column (2026 batch, Indian nationals, 'Others' category): tuition 2,00,000/semester x4 = 8,00,000; 'Other specified fees' (library, teaching aid, computational facilities) 1,74,300/semester x4 = 6,97,200; non-statutory fees 8,150/semester (exam 2,400 + gymkhana 2,400 + benevolent 800 + accident insurance 400 + medical 2,150) x4 = 32,600; one-time admission fees 16,000 (admission 9,650 + alumni 5,000 + welfare 1,350). Other fees = 6,97,200+32,600+16,000 = 7,45,800. Refundable security deposits (10,000) excluded. SC/ST/PwD pay no tuition. Living: 2026-27 hostel circular for PG/MBA new entrants, per semester hostel charges 9,150 + electricity/water 4,000 + amenities 2,100 + mess advance 27,000 = 42,250; x2 semesters = 84,500/yr (excludes refundable Rs 5,000 hostel-mess deposit; mess advance is a deposit drawn against meals). Duration 24 months inferred from 4 semesters of fees and the '2024-26' batch label. Fees for later semesters can be revised (the circular says so; the 2025 batch pays less 'other specified fees' than the 2026 batch). Admission criteria taken from the SJMSOM brochure for the 2025-27 batch (file is named 2026 but text says 2025-27).

programmes.institution: Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), University of Delhi
programmes.fee_year: MBA Full-Time 2026-28 information bulletin (semester fee stated as approximate)

entry_salary.basis: median CTC of the FMS batch 2024-26 final placements (307 students, 287 offers); average INR 32.27 lakh, top-100 average INR 45.196 lakh, highest INR 1.1 crore

requirements.entrance: CAT 2025 score (weighted CAT score is 50% of shortlisting) then group discussion/interview
requirements.academic: Bachelor's degree after 12 years of schooling with at least 50% (SC/ST: passing marks; OBC-NCL/EWS/PwD/CW: 45%) or equivalent CGPA
requirements.work_experience: Not required (54% of the 2024-26 batch were freshers)

programmes.notes: Bulletin says 'The semester fee is currently approximately Rs. 60,818/- for MBA programme, per each semester' and that fees can be revised by the University of Delhi; tuition = 60,818 x 4 = 2,43,272 (a stated approximation; this covers all university fees combined, no itemised list so other_fees null). No official hostel/mess or cost-of-living figure found (bulletin only lists University of Delhi hostels without charges), so living is null and status is partial. Median 29.59 lakh read from the official final placement report (page 7 'MEDIAN CTC 29.59 L').

programmes.stipend_note: No stipend; IIMB offers need-based financial aid (100/80/60/40/20 percent) for households under INR 8 lakh.

entry_salary.basis: median salary of the combined PGP + PGPBA 2024-26 batch final placements (605 students, 665 offers); average INR 35.35 lakh

programmes.notes: Fee: 'Fees for 2 years Rs 26,00,000' covers tuition, library, internet, case royalty, course material, HOSTEL ROOM RENT and service charge, medical and accident insurance, alumni activity; excludes taxes. Other compulsory fees therefore folded into tuition (other_fees null by design, not missing). Caution deposit Rs 30,000 is one-time deposit, excluded. Mess advance Rs 30,000 'each term' is stated but the page does not say how many terms the PGP has or whether it is refundable, so living_per_year is null rather than guessed. Median is for PGP and PGPBA combined (IIMB does not publish PGP alone). Admission requirements not read from an official page (programme admission pages returned 404/403). The separate pgp-programme-expenses page returned 403 to automated access.
